name: Bogdan Rzońca - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the proposal for a decision of the European Parliament and of the Council on the mobilisation of the European Globalisation Adjustment Fund for Displaced Workers following an application from Belgium – EGF/2025/001 BE/BelGaN
part_text:
1. The European Parliament agrees that Belgium should receive money from a European fund that helps workers who lose their jobs. The chip maker BelGaN went bankrupt in July 2024 and 417 people lost their jobs. The fund will pay 931,690 euros, which is 85 percent of the cost of helping these workers. The help includes job advice, training, digital skills, job fairs and help finding new work.

2. • Belgium gets 931,690 euros to help 417 former BelGaN workers find new jobs.
• The money pays for training, job advice and job-search support for these workers.
• Parliament approves the payment; the decision then takes effect and the money is released.
